title.en: Reddish brown timber cabinet in a courtyard

alt.tr: Karo zemin üzerinde yatay tahtalı, üç kapaklı ve parlak kızıl kahve tonlu ahşap dolap
alt.en: Glossy reddish brown timber cabinet with three horizontal board doors on a tiled courtyard

caption.tr: Üç kapaklı dolap yatay tahtalardan yapıldı ve parlak bir yüzeyle bitirildi.
caption.en: The three-door cabinet is built from horizontal boards and has a glossy finish.
